atomic_write_policy: prepare all six final file contents first; create one Git tree/commit with the current main HEAD as parent; advance main exactly once; do not publish formal archive files through six sequential contents-API commits unless atomic Git-data operations are unavailable

required_steps: create staging branch from current main
write all six required archive paths
confirm staging branch contains every required path
open a pull request to main
repair validation failures on the same staging branch
merge the pull request into main
verify the historical report exists on main
fallback_policy.success_condition: archive_status=success only after the pull request is merged or main is otherwise verified to contain all six paths
fallback_policy.forbidden_terminal_state: a staging branch with unmerged report files is never a completed archive
fallback_policy.validation_failure_policy: fix the staging branch and rerun validation; do not merge a known failing report unless the user explicitly overrides
fallback_policy.cleanup_policy: the staging branch may be deleted after successful merge

github_failure_policy: mark_archive_status_failed_or_partial_and report the error; never suppress the research report
archive_status_semantics: archive_status=success means all required repository files are present on main; a completed staging branch alone is partial/pending, not success
ci_validation_semantics: GitHub Actions validation is a separate check; a green Validate Radar Reports result is required before an automated staging-branch merge
citation_policy: GitHub Markdown uses ordinary Markdown links or footnotes; never write ChatGPT-only citation tokens such as filecite, cite, memcite, turn-search IDs or private connector IDs
source_policy: JSON stores a structured sources array with title, publisher, URL when available, source date, access time and supported claims

idempotency.scheduled_run: update the same historical date/edition path if it already exists
idempotency.manual_test: write only under tests/ unless explicitly promoted

never_write: non-public employer information unless expressly approved
